tweet.text: codex has been crashing out on me lately (freezing when i paste large whitepapers in, rendering all wacky, crashing when i launch more than 5 subagents, etc) . in preparation for gpt5.6 sol, i might just bite the bullet and do a full OAI integration into ncode .
